audience: field service business owners and office staff who manage jobs and customers in FieldPulse

useCases.title: List jobs with their status and assignments
useCases.text: The AI lists jobs with type, status, customer, schedule and assignments, within a created-at range or by custom status ids. You see what is open this week.

useCases.title: Check invoices, estimates and payments
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices with status, totals and due dates, estimates with totals and line items, and payments with amount, method and date.

useCases.title: Look up a customer with contacts and service addresses
useCases.text: The AI searches customers, then lists the contacts of one customer and the locations (service addresses) of a customer or job.

useCases.title: Check team timesheets and users
useCases.text: The AI lists timesheet entries with clock in and out, for one user or a time window, and the account's users. You can sum up hours.

useCases.title: Create or update a customer or a job
useCases.text: The AI creates a customer, changes customer fields, creates a job for an existing customer, or updates a job's status, schedule, notes or assignments. Check for duplicate customers first.
